statistical_equivalence_policy: report all 10 seed values, mean, sample sd, confidence interval and paired effect sizes
use matched-seed paired comparisons where valid plus a preregistered multiple-comparison correction
if leading models are statistically or practically indistinguishable, report a top equivalence set instead of manufacturing a unique champion
only if an exact tie-break is needed and frozen in advance use average_MAE_4L, then resource cost
PTE/PIE must not be inserted post hoc as champion tie-breakers
